name: Python Compute
description: Run bounded Python 3 code in a sandboxed process with a curated scientific package set.
capabilities: calculate, solve equations and simulate instead of estimating an answer
fit curves, run regressions, correlations and statistical tests on data
do exact, symbolic or arbitrary-precision math with SymPy
analyze CSV or JSON datasets: aggregate, pivot, join and summarize
plot data as PNG chart images and return tables as CSV
read shared artifacts and publish large compute outputs without base64
analyze graphs and networks: paths, centrality and connectivity
run supplied Python code and return values, output and errors
report which Python packages and versions a node provides

bundle.description: Package set provisioned on the node. core is NumPy only, science adds SciPy, pandas, matplotlib and SymPy, full adds scikit-learn, statsmodels, Shapely and document parsers.

memoryMb.description: Default per-call address-space limit in MB. Omit to size it from the node's memory.

maxMemoryMb.description: Highest per-call address-space limit a caller may request in MB. Omit to size it from the node's memory.

maxTimeoutMs.description: Highest per-call wall-clock limit a caller may request. Omit for the full 10 minutes.

concurrentCalls.description: Calls this node runs at once. Omit to size it from the node's CPU cores.

callsPerMinute.description: Calls this node accepts per minute. Omit to derive it from the concurrency.
